# Trendy Plaza Architecture (LLMs.txt)

> Trendy Plaza Architecture is Algeria's leading dedicated architecture platform, e-commerce shop, and digital learning library for architecture and design students. We provide specialized studio equipment, drafting kits, printed course packs, past exam papers with corrections, and university-aligned online learning resources with nationwide cash on delivery across all wilayas.

---

## Brand Summary & Value Proposition

- **Entity**: Trendy Plaza Architecture (Algeria)
- [Primary Domain](https://trendyplaza.tech)
- **Target Audience**: Architecture, urban planning, and civil engineering students and professionals across Algerian universities (EPAU Alger, Constantine, Oran, Tizi Ouzou, Annaba, Biskra, Blida, Mostaganem, Setif, Batna, etc.).
- **Core Offerings**:
  1. **Studio Supplies & Kit**: Drawing boards, scale rulers (kutch), drafting pens, technical markers, cutting mats, cutters, model-making materials, drawing tubes, tracing paper, portfolio cases.
  2. **Printed Course Packs & Books**: Bound curriculum booklets categorized by university, academic year (L1, L2, L3, M1, M2), and semester, with access cards included.
  3. **LMS Course Platform**: Lecture summaries, past exams with model answers, tutorials, software guides (AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, Lumion, Rhino, Photoshop).
  4. **Nationwide Delivery**: Home and Stop-Desk delivery across all 69 wilayas of Algeria with 100% Cash on Delivery (Paiement à la livraison / الدفع عند الاستلام).
